unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Increasing contrast
drDigitalIntro:
Contrast is the gap between the light parts of the screen and the dark parts.
• Increase Contrast pushes pale colors paler and dark colors darker, so edges and text stand out.
• It is gentler than inverting — the screen keeps looking normal, just sharper.
• It helps with faint gray text and thin dividing lines, which are everywhere in modern software.
• Try it with Bold Text on. The two work well together.

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Click the switch next to Increase Contrast.

drDigitalSuccess: Look at the gray helper text under each setting — it is easier to read now.
drDigitalHint: Increase Contrast is the second switch in the Color and Contrast card.
